id: \rCandice may be an Ice type expert, but not all of her team are Ice types. Be careful.
en: \rCandice may be an Ice type expert, but not all of her team are Ice types. Be careful.
it: \rBianca sarà pure un'esperta del tipo Ghiaccio, ma non tutta la sua squadra è di tipo Ghiaccio. Fai attenzione.

id: \bIf you ever get stuck, try moving the opposite direction.
en: \bIf you ever get stuck, try moving the opposite direction.
it: \bSe resti bloccato, prova a muoverti nella direzione opposta.

id: \rCandice: Welcome to my gym. I see you've overcome the cold to get here.
en: \rCandice: Welcome to my gym. I see you've overcome the cold to get here.
it: \rBianca: Benvenuto nella mia Palestra. Vedo che hai sfidato il freddo per arrivare fin qui.

id: \rPushing yourself to your limit helps you grow past it. Prepare for another one of those challenges.
en: \rPushing yourself to your limit helps you grow past it. Prepare for another one of those challenges.
it: \rSpingersi al limite aiuta a superarlo. Preparati a un'altra di queste sfide.
\rBianca: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Ghiacciolo.

id: \rTM14 contains Blizzard. Freeze your opponents cold with it.
en: \rTM14 contains Blizzard. Freeze your opponents cold with it.
it: \rLa MT14 contiene Bora. Congela i tuoi avversari con questa mossa.

id: \rCandice: Push yourself. If you try hard things you will grow.
en: \rCandice: Push yourself. If you try hard things you will grow.
it: \rBianca: Mettiti alla prova. Se affronti le cose difficili, crescerai.

id: \rFor ice freezing things we sure move a lot in this place.
en: \rFor ice freezing things we sure move a lot in this place.
it: \rPer essere un posto dove il ghiaccio congela tutto, qui ci muoviamo parecchio.

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.

id: \bCandice uses Ice type Pokémon. They are weak against the Fire, Fighting, Rock, and Steel types.
en: \bCandice uses Ice type Pokémon. They are weak against the Fire, Fighting, Rock, and Steel types.
it: \bBianca usa Pokémon di tipo Ghiaccio. Sono deboli contro i tipi Fuoco, Lotta, Roccia e Acciaio.

id: \bThey are strong against Dragon, Flying, Grass, and Ground. They are resistant to only Ice.
en: \bThey are strong against Dragon, Flying, Grass, and Ground. They are resistant to only Ice.
it: \bSono forti contro Drago, Volante, Erba e Terra. Resistono soltanto al Ghiaccio.
